build_sapiens_det_package: build the sapiens_det package by running python setup.py install with CUDA support
parse_requirements_file: parse a requirements.txt file and return a list of package dependencies with version specs
create_cuda_extension: create a CUDA or C++ extension module for PyTorch with automatic CUDA detection
get_package_version: get the package version string by reading and executing mmdet/version.py
add_mim_extension_files: add MIM support files by creating symlinks or copies for editable installs
